title: Archiwum 60 s — ZE13 12 — fizyczny przelew
description: Poza timeline’em wersji 42 s. Zachowany projekt wcześniejszego wariantu. Oddzielny detal samego przekazania pieniędzy. Jedna główna czynność, dwie dłonie, bez twarzy. Halinka podaje prawą, Wiesław odbiera lewą. Etap projektu: zaprojektowany placeholder; Start Frame i take nie zostały wygenerowane.

prompts.image:
Create exactly one photorealistic cinematic 16:9 START FRAME, target 1920x1080. Natural diffuse daylight through the missing roof, restrained 35mm texture, real skin and materials. Mandatory references in attachment order:
Image 1: shot:ze13-11-halinka-na-cement, established scene geography, props, light and costume continuity; change the framing/action only as specified below.
Image 2: shot:ze13-10-pieniadze-z-portfela, established scene geography, props, light and costume continuity; change the framing/action only as specified below.
Images 3 and 4: character:halinka, exact facial identity and full-body wardrobe/proportions. Reference-sheet labels and white studio backgrounds are not scene elements.
Images 5 and 6: character:wieslaw-majster, exact facial identity and full-body wardrobe/proportions. Reference-sheet labels and white studio backgrounds are not scene elements.

Tight hand insert on the SAME SIDE of the exchange. Halinka’s burgundy-sleeved RIGHT hand enters from SCREEN LEFT holding the one folded banknote. Wieslaw’s mustard-sleeved LEFT hand enters from SCREEN RIGHT, open palm just 5cm away, not touching yet. No faces or torsos. Match exact note fold from ze13-10 and offered orientation from ze13-11. Background table edge and stationary wheelbarrow are soft; Wieslaw has parked the cart before the exchange. No other hands, no phone in either hand.
Keep the hall roofless and ruined. Preserve all existing visible source lettering and logos on included scene objects; do not transplant reference-sheet annotations. No added people, repaired roof, supernatural light, oversized smoke, illustration, captions, watermark, montage or malformed anatomy. Mouths rest naturally before dialogue. No End Frame is required.
prompts.animation: 0–1s: Wieslaw’s left thumb and fingers close gently on the free end of the offered folded note. 1–1.8s: only after his grip is secure, Halinka’s right fingers release it. 1.8–3s: the hands separate by 10 cm, with the whole note remaining in Wieslaw’s left hand. Never duplicate, stretch or dissolve the note. Camera: locked-off, one continuous shot. Secondary motion: natural breathing and minor fabric settling only. Continuity: preserve the exact identities, anatomy, costumes, props, ruined architecture, daylight and any visible lettering from Start Frame. Avoid new people, duplicate objects, extra limbs, face morphing, cuts, fades, captions and watermarks.
